messages:
Kay: Kicking off a short thread to capture follow-ups from the recurring-incident sweep. Top three repeating issues we saw: scale-down races, KV eviction storms, and model rollout regressions. Need owners, brief mitigation plans, and measurable acceptance criteria to close loop.

Ravi: Can we make sure remediation items are single-line so the recurrence board can import automatically? Format: owner | action | ETA. Also include a 2-3 step oncall mitigation for each.

Jules: Quick counts I pulled for last 9 weeks: total recurrences = 12. scale-down=5, eviction=4, rollout=3. Customer-impact ranking: scale-down > eviction > rollout. I'll add a CSV to the recurrence board after this.

Maya: I'll take eviction storms. Short-term fix: enable hot-prefix cache + cap request batch variance at edge. Rollout: feature-flag -> 1-region canary (48h) -> global. Success: 60% reduction in cache-induced 5xx within 4w. ETA: 2026-04-10. Playbook (oncall): 1) set cache to readonly, 2) enable prefix-hot-cache flag, 3) scale cache nodes for region.

Ravi: I'll own scale-down races. Short-term: increase scale-down graceful window 30s->100s for warm pools and suspend aggressive downscales during nightly backups. Rollout: canary pool A -> region -> global. Success: pod churn reduction >=50% and recurrence count cut by 50% in 6w. ETA: 2026-04-03. Playbook: 1) increase graceful window, 2) disable downscale for pool, 3) route critical traffic to warm pool.

Jules: I'll own model rollout regressions. Short-term: add tokenization preflight in rollout pipeline and checksum parity test between variants. Block swap if mismatch >0.2%. Rollout: pipeline change -> test run -> gated swap. Success: zero repeat rollbacks for next quarter. ETA: 2026-04-18. Playbook: 1) revert model to previous variant, 2) run tokenization dry-run, 3) block swaps and alert model-onboarding.

tool-bot: created ticket #INC-2026-1509 "Eviction cascade follow-up" linked.

Kay: Please paste one-line action items below (owner | action | ETA) so I can import to the recurrence board. Also confirm ownership with a quick :white_check_mark:.

Maya: "Maya | enable hot-prefix cache + cap batch variance | 2026-04-10" :white_check_mark:

Ravi: "Ravi | bump graceful window + backup gating | 2026-04-03" :white_check_mark:

Jules: "Jules | add tokenization preflight + checksum check | 2026-04-18" :white_check_mark:

Kay: I'll import these to the board and add the playbook snippets. I'll also ask reliability to check owner workload and rebalance if anyone has >4 open remediations. Follow-up sync in 7 days to review canary metrics. Closing thread — reopen if blockers appear. :rocket:
